intent: A working professional adjacent to the domain: follows its outcomes and implications but not its internal methods.
domain_familiarity: Follows the domain's news, products, and outcomes; not its internal methods or standard tooling.
purpose: Wants to understand implications for decisions adjacent to the domain — should this change what I do, buy, or recommend.
assumed_knowledge: high-level familiarity with the domain's major concepts and recent history, not its internal methods

text.explanation_depth: gloss method-level or internal jargon; assume familiarity with outcomes-level vocabulary
text.section_granularity: medium sections organized around decisions and implications rather than mechanism

visual.legend: shown when the encoding is not self-evident to someone outside the field
visual.acronym_expansion: expand acronyms specific to the domain's internal practice; widely known business acronyms need no expansion

audio.term_glossing: gloss method-specific jargon only; skip glossing for outcomes-level vocabulary

anti_patterns: Assuming fluency in the domain's internal methods or standard tooling
Explaining widely known business or product vocabulary as if it were domain-specific
Framing every implication as a decision when the piece is informational
